question: What was revenue in the United Kingdom last year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE i.billing_country = 'United Kingdom' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice)

question: Which city had the highest revenue overall?
sql: SELECT i.billing_city, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id GROUP BY i.billing_city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show revenue by genre for last year.
sql: SELECT g.name AS genre, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: How many active customers are there in Canada?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Canada' AND i.invoice_date > (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) FROM invoice) - INTERVAL '12 months'

question: List active customers by country.
sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date > (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) FROM invoice) - INTERVAL '12 months' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY active_customers DESC

question: What was the average order value last year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice)

question: What is the average order value for each year?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many units of Rock tracks did we sell?
sql: SELECT SUM(il.quantity) AS units_sold FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Rock'

question: Units sold by media type last year.
sql: SELECT mt.name AS media_type, SUM(il.quantity) AS units_sold FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN media_type mt ON mt.media_type_id = t.media_type_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY mt.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC

question: What is the lifetime value of each customer in Germany?
sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS lifetime_value FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN invoice_line il ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE c.country = 'Germany' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC

question: Which customer has the lowest lifetime value?
sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS lifetime_value FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN invoice_line il ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY lifetime_value ASC LIMIT 1

question: How much revenue did Jane Peacock's customers generate last year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id WHERE e.first_name = 'Jane' AND e.last_name = 'Peacock' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice)

question: Rank sales reps by revenue last year.
sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS sales_rep, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: How many customers does each sales rep manage?
sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS sales_rep, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY customers DESC

question: Which region had the lowest revenue last year?
sql: SELECT i.billing_country AS region, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY i.billing_country ORDER BY revenue ASC LIMIT 1

question: What share of last year's revenue came from the USA?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.billing_country = 'USA' THEN il.unit_price * il.quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 1) AS usa_share_percent FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice)

question: How did revenue last year compare with the year before?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) >= (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) - 1 FROM invoice) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: What was revenue by quarter last year?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM i.invoice_date) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Which artist earned the most revenue?
sql: SELECT ar.name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Top 10 albums by revenue.
sql: SELECT al.title AS album, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id GROUP BY al.album_id, al.title ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many tracks have never been sold?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unsold_tracks FROM track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_line il WHERE il.track_id = t.track_id)

question: What is the average track price by media type?
sql: SELECT mt.name AS media_type, ROUND(AVG(t.unit_price), 2) AS average_price FROM track t JOIN media_type mt ON mt.media_type_id = t.media_type_id GROUP BY mt.name ORDER BY average_price DESC

question: How many invoices were issued in each country last year?
sql: SELECT billing_country AS country, COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM invoice WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY invoices DESC

question: Which customers were active last year but spent less than 5?
sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN invoice_line il ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) < 5 ORDER BY revenue

question: How many playlists contain at least one Jazz track?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playlist_id) AS playlists FROM playlist_track pt JOIN track t ON t.track_id = pt.track_id JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Jazz'

question: What is the longest track in the catalogue?
sql: SELECT name, milliseconds FROM track ORDER BY milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which employees report to Andrew Adams?
sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee, e.title FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON m.employee_id = e.reports_to WHERE m.first_name = 'Andrew' AND m.last_name = 'Adams'

question: How many customers are in each city in Brazil?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil' GROUP BY city ORDER BY customers DESC

question: Monthly units sold last year.
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.invoice_date) AS month, SUM(il.quantity) AS units_sold FROM invoice_line il JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = (SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many customers bought something in every year of the data?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM invoice GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) FROM invoice)) t
